text: What...what is all this?!\nWe need to help Lee![VAR 0114(0005)]
And what do you plan on doing,\nGym Challenger?[VAR 0114(0006)]

Uh, pardon?
What are you talking about?\c
There’s nothing to stop now. We’ve already
brought about the Darkest Day...or should I say,
the ultimate Pokémon—Eternatus![VAR 0114(0006)]
I’m afraid I can’t allow that.\c\nThe Champion is the one who needs to\ncontrol Eternatus.[VAR 0114(0006)]

Must I explain myself?\c
From your perspective, I suppose it must
seem that I am doing something terrible.
I don’t expect you to understand.\c
But I must provide the Galar region with limitless
energy to ensure everlasting prosperity.\c
It is my purpose, my duty, my destiny![VAR 0114(0006)]

That’s why we’ve been giving the Wishing Stars
to Eternatus!\c
Surely you remember the red light that caused a
ruckus around Hammerlocke. That was all part of
our experiments to awaken Eternatus!\c
You must understand. I can’t let you interfere
with my plan to protect the future of Galar![VAR 0114(0006)]
